question: Does a declared glucose-responsive liver input change simulated plasma glucose relative to controls with the same basal plasma insulin, within one pinned synthetic metabolic route?

source.equations: 23-26, p1745; Table I p1743 normal column
source.threshold: initial native plasma glucose, x[3]/Vg; engineering adaptation of h=Gb
source.baseline: engineering replacement below, not published healthy Sb

boundary.glucose_rate: native dx[3]/Vg at the same RHS evaluation
boundary.liver_input: S=gamma*P added to guarded dx[9] only
boundary.portal_egp_term: not added; native has no direct portal insulin action
boundary.cpeptide: excluded from first feedback experiment; no implicit reuse of insulin transit

basal_replacement.not_a_claim: replacement fraction is a prescribed experiment design; no estimate of insulin need or functional cell fraction

derived_controls.input: replay archived liver-arrival S(t) on the identical native initial state and SC schedule; no responsive secretion states in this replay
constant archived integral(S)/horizon; same initial native states and SC schedule as parent; explicitly a dose-and-initial-state matched diagnostic, not its own steady basal state
derived_controls.purpose: timing versus amount; not prospective prediction

input_semantics: single initial gastric solid load at t=0, not native announce-meal rate; last_Qsto=load, last_foodtaken=0, Action.CHO=0 throughout, constant SC basal, no bolus/controller/pump/sensor
integration: monolithic native+Z+P+ledgers; no sensor derivative, finite-difference glucose or sequential stale feedback; same-state derivative has no instantaneous dependence on S

refinement.refine_source: save feedback_full S at all refinement grids from the reference solve
refinement.transfer: piecewise linear and split at knots; report each trapezoidal amount; record sampling separately from solver error

failure_policy: preserve every attempt; reject incomplete/nonfinite solver output; terminate on glucose envelope exit or negative mass beyond tolerance; signed native insulin-action state x[6] may be negative; no clipping to conceal failure; do not summarize a shortened run as a completed 240-minute case; no post-result tuning
outcomes: G(t), plasma insulin, Spo(t), S(t), Z,P and every native state
baseline-relative plasma glucose AUC 0-240 using signed trapezoids
sampled glucose peak/nadir and final glucose
integrals of SC input, pancreatic input, liver arrival and losses
all failures and switches; solver/replay sensitivity
paired contrasts versus constant_basal; equal-amount timing diagnostic
identifiability: no fitting or human recovery; gain is exactly confounded with common scaling of beta and K; basal fraction affects initialization independently; evaluate no unique human capacity from glucose alone
go_no_go: preflight is necessary only; implement separate secretion closed-form/reference tests before coupling; classify effects unresolved if <10 times the largest absolute contrast change under refinement; no required effect direction or magnitude; failed controls prevent accepting scenario contrasts
excluded: BC001 modification or arbitrary replay into its IVGTT reduction
time-varying hepatic extraction or direct portal EGP restoration
cell count, transplant site or treatment efficacy
human validation or external domain review

protocol_history.change: Separate rate-state Z closed-form tolerance from mass-state P tolerance; both remain 1e-7 in their own units. No feedback execution has occurred and preflight criteria are unchanged.
